text.en: Warm PIC: Landau damping and two-stream instability Compare self-consistent weighted full-f PIC with independently formulated dielectric dispersion and linear Volterra IVPs. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group.
